answers.text: "Energy is not my gate; the Template passes." On my test energy is a weighted engine: `energy` 56.3 sits under its 60 floor, `sc_m_gates` False, and R4 is live (`subcomponents.energy.en_trend_bars` 22.0, `subcomponents.energy.exhaustion_score` 7.0). The 3-month lead (`subcomponents.structure.rs_vs_spy` 21.91) I already credited; R6 still holds with `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` -1.04. W/D HH/HL is not my menu. No concession.

"No volume; buy point passed." `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 1.5 is my own field and I named it as the case against; it stands as thinness, not a failure: `flow` 69.7 clears its 60 floor on `subcomponents.flow.flow_score` 17.0. The claim was path and structure: `pipe_rank` 90.5, `structure` 89.5, `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` 17.67 are unrefuted. The D swing distance is not on my menu. Partial point taken, claim holds.

"In a power-play flag volume must dry up." A flag is not on my menu. On my fields the heaviest engine fails: `flow` 57.9 under its floor with `subcomponents.flow.volume_score` 0.0, `sc_m_gates` False. The 1m-vs-3m erosion is exactly what `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` -26.37 measures and `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel_score` 0.0 scores it. No concession.

"Drying volume and slowing push are a retracement." The retracement reading is your method; my fields agree with my claim, not against it: `mp_accel_state` DECELERATING and `subcomponents.flow.volume_score` 0.0 are the slowing you cite. `subcomponents.mp.adx_val` 49.99 is trend strength I credit, but `flow` 57.9 still fails its floor. H1 9<21 is not my test. No concession.

"No fresh base or buying." Base is step 7, n/a for an extended name (A9), so `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 5.0 is not a case against here. `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 1.5 is thin, but `flow` 69.7 clears its floor on `subcomponents.flow.flow_score` 17.0, and R2/R5/R8/R9 stand: `mp` 100.0, `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` 17.39, A-TIER + ACCELERATING, `subcomponents.mp.roc_zscore` 2.54. No concession.

"Trend passes; concentration is no flaw." You confirm my weights: `flow` 52.6 and `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 1.5, `mp_accel_state` DECELERATING. `subcomponents.mp.adx_val` 47.86 and `pipe_rank` 81.7 I accept as strength, but the heaviest engine fails its floor (`sc_m_gates` False). The sector remark was not my reason and I withdraw it. Claim holds on the fields.

"The base is the strongest read; pipe_rank 0 is missing." Agreed that `pipe_rank` 0 is a missing reading; I declared it so, never a zero. `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 15.0 on `subcomponents.structure.base_days` 24.0 I credit inside `structure` 87.4. But the heaviest engine shows money leaving: `flow` 36.8, `subcomponents.flow.accum_score` 0.0, `subcomponents.flow.cmf` -0.09. Narrow case stands.

"A test of the prior high with trend and base." A test of a high is not on my menu. You concede `flow` 36.8, which is my claim. `subcomponents.mp.adx_val` 31.72 and `subcomponents.energy.exhaustion_score` 10.0 are real, but `subcomponents.flow.cmf` -0.09 says closes near the lows on volume and `sc_m_gates` is False on flow. No concession.
